limitations: Direct current API adapter evidence, not HTTP or UI execution.
Two predeclared non-atomic unsigned sequences at one freshly selected block-end state, not representative coverage or signed historical replay.
The funded profile deliberately selects its sender and amounts using prior observations; it does not replace or reclassify previous failed cases.
Later targets use the frozen hash; only first dispatch has the declared freshness gate.
Both sides use eth.drpc.org infrastructure; provider state/execution is not independently consensus authenticated.
Local getters use 1M gas after all originals; provider getters use 300k gas between originals. Query comparison is observational only.
State comparison is observed cumulative net changes, not complete public-chain poststate roots.
Saved validators and query compiler are shared with the product; this checker does not execute another EVM.
Frozen control flow and sampled clocks are not independently trusted timestamps.
Direct-worker closure and cleanup signalling do not independently attest OS process-tree extinction.
